question: Why do adherents of limited vision mistake their own doctrine for the true essence?
premises: Those fixed in small vision do not grasp insistence properly.
They know only their own speech.
They take that speech as the very essence.
inference: Limited perspectives absolutize their own partial doctrine as ultimate truth.
uncertainties: na grāhitā āgraham can be read in more than one syntactic way.
plain_english: Adherents of limited vision do not take insistence rightly; they know only their own doctrine and regard it as the very essence.
